name: Stardust Spire
summary: Stardust Spire is an ancient elven watchtower perched in the forested hills of southern Ashenvale, looking down toward Talondeep Pass. Standing atop the remnants of a far older structure, it sits adjacent to the haunted Ruins of Stardust, serving as an enduring sentinel over the mountain road.

sections.title: A Sentry on the Mountain Pass
sections.body: Stardust Spire consists of a reinforced night elf sentry tower constructed over the crumbling foundation of a much larger ancient elven ruin. Located just north of the crags of Talondeep Pass leading into the Stonetalon Mountains, its high vantage point provides a clear view over the southern woodlands of Ashenvale. The tower takes its name from the nearby Ruins of Stardust, where restless spirits linger among fallen colonnades and moonlit waters.

faq.answer: It stands in southern Ashenvale, situated upon high ground just north of the trail leading into Talondeep Pass and the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why is it called Stardust Spire?
faq.answer: The tower is named after the nearby Ruins of Stardust, an ancient elven site nestled among the nearby trees and waters.
The present watchtower sits directly atop the stonework and foundations of a far larger structure built by the ancient night elves prior to the Sundering.

angles.text: Stardust Spire represents the enduring vigil of your kin, guarding the southern approaches to Ashenvale from an ancient, shored-up watchtower.
Positioned over the southern routes into Ashenvale, this vantage point watches over the winding passes that connect the forest to the Stonetalon Mountains.
